methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents organized community-level AI exploration outside metro centers, signaling potential for distributed capability building if evaluation translates to implementation and peer learning networks.

signals.title: Warner, Anthropic launch AI pilot to help Hampton Roads military families find local resources - The Legacy Newspaper
signals.signal_reading: Platform-delivered AI (Anthropic) targeting military families creates broad but shallow adoption in Hampton Roads—useful service access without building local AI development capacity or technical depth.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's E911 AI implementation demonstrates operational AI adoption in municipal services, but reliance on vendor solutions creates shallow distribution rather than indigenous capability development.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Statewide cybersecurity AI plan will likely concentrate technical implementation capacity in NoVA and Richmond where expertise exists, creating coordination infrastructure but not necessarily distributing deep capability.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon scrapping NoVA data centers signals infrastructure saturation concerns that could slow AI development investment even in Virginia's strongest tech hub, while offering no alternative distribution mechanisms to other regions.
